html: RFC 0003 opened for comment, with a window of 30 November 2026 to 8 January 2027 and an issue as the comment thread: RFC 0003, a profile defining the five workforce health measures the UK government has named and not defined (work ability, absence, sustained return, retention and disability participation), a minimum group size rule that names the floors already in the specification and sets out how small numbers are withheld or merged, and two proposed record types, CommitmentEvent for the dated commitments and ProviderReturn for a common group-level return from a provider to an employer. The three proposals can be decided separately. Nothing in the specification changes until a decision is recorded, and none of it is endorsed by any government department, by BSI or by anyone else. The open review page lists it, and now says that the comment windows for RFCs 0001 and 0002 closed on 17 October 2026 with no decision yet recorded.
